# CANDIDATE: ATR_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When ATR contracts to extreme lows (indicating suppressed volatility), a break above the prior day's high on elevated volume signals an imminent volatility expansion move upward. This captures the edge of low-volatility environments preceding explosive moves, which exists because market participants often underestimate the potential for volatility expansion after prolonged compression.

## Mechanism

Compute ATR(20). If ATR(20) ≤ 0.10 × max ATR(20) over the last 50 bars and price closes above the prior day's high on a bar with volume > 1.5 × the 20-bar average volume, go long at the bar's close. Exit: Chart-stop at the prior day's low (structure invalidation), TP1 at 2R, runner trailed 20% off highest-water-mark using a chandelier exit. Regime hints: Best in low-volatility regimes (VIX < 18) and during midday 10:30-14:00; avoid first-30-min opening-range turbulence.
